provider: VK Video (video hosting as bulk store)

free_tier.stated: up to 256 GB per single uploaded file; no per-account total published on the page read

egress.terms: free to viewers — playback is served from VK's own streaming CDN, no per-GB charge to the uploader

tooling: yt-dlp VK extractor (yt_dlp/extractor/vk.py) for retrieval; VK API video.save / video upload for pushing files
chaining: per-record, not per-account: 256 GB per upload x unlimited videos on one account. Shards by file, so it multiplies without new identities.
limits_note: 256 GB single file; video must be a real playable video container (arbitrary bytes only survive if 'original file download' is enabled by the uploader); retrieval goes through the player/extractor path
reliability_note: Uploaded media may be transcoded; non-video payloads die on transcode; VK periodically changes the playback protocol and breaks yt-dlp (yt-dlp issues 16070/11715 track exactly this churn), and content can be removed for complaints.

evidence.proved: 'Видео ВКонтакте теперь поддерживает загрузку «тяжёлых» файлов размером до 256 Гбайт'
'[VK Video] supposedly updated protocol inhibits downloads' (retrieval breaks periodically)

notes: up to 256 GB per single uploaded file; no per-account total published on the page read
binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
